verdict.rationale: First-party docs say users can 'Connect MCP servers to Copilot Chat to share context from other applications' (github-docs-28). Further docs show Copilot Chat in the IDE consuming the GitHub MCP server's tools for repos, issues and PRs, configured remotely or locally (github-docs-29, github-docs-30, github-docs-66). missing for 10: detail on configuring arbitrary third-party MCP servers beyond a one-line summary, evidence of MCP support in Copilot cloud agent and Copilot CLI (not just IDE chat), independent or hands-on corroboration.
